'''Quooria''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Yesterday Today" /> located in the [[Quooria system/Legends|Quooria system]], a part of the [[Farstey sector/Legends|Farstey sector]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Quoorian marshsucker]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature similar to, but much more [[Death/Legends|deadlier]] than [[Mosquito/Legends|mosquitos]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> In addition, creatures that were related to Quoorian marshsuckers eventually went extinct on Quooria and became preserved in the [[Sap/Legends|sap]] of the celestial body's [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="Yesterday Today" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
When an ancient [[Disease/Legends|disease]] resurfaced<ref name="Yesterday Today" /> at some point by [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date SoR">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the majority of the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] take place in approximately [[3637 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "Yesterday Today" is part of the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion and therefore also takes place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the future [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]]<ref name="Commander">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}} establishes that [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;who becomes the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the future [[Eternal Alliance]] in "Chapter IX: The Alliance"&mdash;also was the player-controlled character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.</ref> sent a companion to Quooria to collect samples from the preserved species, as there existed a possibility that the creatures held the key to combating the disease.<ref name="Yesterday Today" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Quooria was introduced in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']],<ref name="Yesterday Today" /> a [[2014]] expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="SoR release date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20141202|text=Welcome to Shadow of Revan Early Access!}}</ref> a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="SWTOR base game date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111213|text=EARLY GAME ACCESS FOR THE OLD REPUBLIC BEGINS TODAY}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Quooria [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Quooria, in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA Quooria" />
